title: Saved-code child buttons
description: Expose each saved Broadlink IR/RF code as a managed Hubitat child Button device beneath its Broadlink Remote parent. Preserve existing saved-code commands, app synchronization, and parent behavior while supporting child lifecycle reconciliation and dashboard use.

title: Validate Hubitat child Button driver and identity strategy
description: Perform the design spike before implementation. Confirm whether Generic Component Button is usable for dynamically created children or a local Button driver is needed; verify child creation/deletion/data APIs; choose deterministic network IDs; define rename behavior, child metadata, and malformed/stale-child handling. Record the decisions in the feature document or a focused design note.
close_reason: Spike resolved: use hubitat Generic Component Button Controller; derive child DNI from a stable digest of the exact code name; store codeName child metadata; recreate children on rename; keep app unchanged.

title: Integrate saved-code child Button Controller
description: Use Hubitat’s built-in hubitat / Generic Component Button Controller for saved-code children; do not add a local child driver unless implementation testing proves the built-in driver cannot satisfy the required dashboard push behavior. Configure each child as a one-button child and ensure parent componentPush(child, button) delegates the associated code once through sendSavedCode. Package or document any required driver selection details.
close_reason: Implemented parent componentPush callback for the built-in Generic Component Button Controller. It reads child codeName metadata, safely rejects stale/orphaned children, ignores the button number for one-code-per-child semantics, and delegates one send through sendSavedCode.

title: Add parent child reconciliation helpers
description: In broadlinkRemoteDriver or the helper library, add idempotent reconciliation for state.codes. Create missing children, update child metadata/display names, remove stale children, and avoid accidental association with another code. Use the identity and driver decisions from the spike.

title: Integrate child lifecycle with saved-code mutations
description: Wire reconciliation or targeted lifecycle updates into addSavedCode, importCodes, renameSavedCode, deleteSavedCode, clearSavedCodes, and all learned/Pronto/LIRC import paths. Preserve savedCodes events and existing command behavior, including System Manager synchronization.

title: Reconcile children during initialization and updates
description: Invoke reconciliation from initialize/updated so existing installations recover from missed events, stale children are removed, and a parent with no saved codes has no code children. Ensure repeated initialization is idempotent.

title: Verify IR, RF, import, rename, delete, and dashboard behavior
description: Add or document validation covering learned and imported IR/RF codes, Pronto/LIRC imports, app synchronization, duplicate-name overwrite behavior, punctuation/spaces/Unicode names, rename handling, deletion, clear-all, driver update recovery, child push events, and EZ Dashboard tiles. Update feature documentation with final behavior and known limitations.
